annotations.title: Save this app's bundle ID, Team ID and store details

description: Saves what the app IS to Apple, Google and the web: the iOS bundle ID and Apple Team ID (which build the Universal Links file), the Android package and signing fingerprints (which build the App Links file), both store addresses and the website. Send only the fields you know. Every value is checked before saving, because a bad one makes links fail with no error anywhere. A value already saved is not overwritten unless replace_existing is true: changing a bundle ID on a live app breaks its links, so ask the person first. Needs read and edit access.

android_sha256.description: SHA-256 signing fingerprints, 32 hex pairs split by colons

ios_team_id.description: Apple Team ID, 10 letters and digits

replace_existing.description: Overwrite values already saved. Only after the person has agreed.
